The bank cannot execute on the mortgage. Under the majority rule in a lien-theory state, one joint tenant’s mortgage is only a lien: it does not transfer title and does not sever the joint tenancy, so his death ends his interest and extinguishes the lien, and she takes the whole property by survivorship free of it. A rule that the mortgage transfers title and severs the tenancy is title theory, which does not apply here.
CONFIDENCE: 92
